errors.text_span: Jede Rohstoffkategorie enthält zwei nebeneinander stehende Balken, die durch eine Legende als „2021“ (dunkelblau) und „2022“ (hellblau) gekennzeichnet sind.
errors.evidence: The figure uses three colors: blue for 2021, violet for 2022, and gray for 2023. The description incorrectly states that only two colors (dark blue and light blue) are used.
The description does not explicitly state that the chart shows the percentage of Russian imports of industrial raw materials for Germany and the EU.
The description does not mention the grouping of bars by year (2021, 2022, 2023) or the presence of three bars per category.
The description does not mention the labeling of the vertical axis as '%'.
The description does not mention that the horizontal axis categories (Aluminium, Kupfer, Nickel) are labeled in German.
